mapper.sql: COALESCE(r.status, CASE d.da_status WHEN '1' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN '2' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN '3' THEN 'REVIEWING' WHEN '4' THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'PENDING' END)

d.idx AS id, d.da_rider AS reporter, d.da_latitude AS latitude, d.da_longitude AS longitude, d.da_addr AS address, d.da_image AS image, d.da_content AS description, d.da_status AS legacy_status, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.title, ''), LEFT(COALESCE(d.da_content, '위험지역 제보'), 120)) AS title, COALESCE(r.hazard_type, 'OTHER') AS hazard_type, AS status, COALESCE(r.created_at, d.create_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS created_at, COALESCE(r.updated_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at, r.approved_at, r.approved_by, r.rejection_reason, COALESCE(r.confirm_count, 0) AS confirm_count, COALESCE(r.report_count, 0) AS report_count, COALESCE(r.is_active, 1) AS is_active, r.merged_into
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dangerous_area d LEFT JOIN trailgo_hazard_review r ON r.hazard_id = d.idx ORDER BY COALESCE(r.created_at, d.create_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) DESC, d.idx DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM dangerous_area d LEFT JOIN trailgo_hazard_review r ON r.hazard_id = d.idx WHERE d.idx = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dangerous_area d LEFT JOIN trailgo_hazard_review r ON r.hazard_id = d.idx WHERE = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO trailgo_hazard_review (hazard_id, title, hazard_type, status, created_at, updated_at, confirm_count, report_count, is_active) SELECT d.idx, LEFT(COALESCE(d.da_content, '위험지역 제보'), 120), 'OTHER', CASE d.da_status WHEN '1' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN '2' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN '3' THEN 'REVIEWING' WHEN '4' THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'PENDING' END, COALESCE(d.create_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0, CASE WHEN d.da_status = '4' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM dangerous_area d WHERE d.idx = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE trailgo_hazard_review SET status = #{status}, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE approved_at END, approved_by = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN #{adminId} ELSE approved_by END, rejection_reason = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'REJECTED' THEN #{reason} ELSE NULL END, is_active = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('INACTIVE', 'EXPIRED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE hazard_id = #{id}
UPDATE dangerous_area SET da_status = #{legacyStatus} WHERE idx = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trailgo_hazard_history (hazard_id, action, previous_status, next_status, admin_id, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{hazardId}, #{action}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, #{adminId}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
